Ooze · 13 hexes · SM +5 Black Pudding [Monster Manual, page 201]

A shapeless mass of viscous black matter that pours along walls and ceilings as easily as floors, and weighs several tons. It is blind, mindless and entirely without organs, so there is nothing on it to aim at; what it flows over, it digests.

Melee attacks

UsageLevelDamageReach
Engulf (Binding ST 24)No attack roll is necessary; the quarry may defend only by dodging and retreating. Moving through an SM+2 or smaller creature is an automatic slam. A victim who fails to dodge is pinned if smaller than the pudding, or grappled if equal or larger. Breaking free is a Quick Contest of ST (only every 10 seconds if pinned; on a 17 or 18 the victim cannot escape unaided); the pudding has +10 ST when pinning and +5 when grappling. Engulfed victims cannot breathe and begin to suffocate when out of breath. It can pin or grapple one foe at a time; others are pushed along in front of it unless they win a Quick Contest of ST. It may constrict an engulfed victim every turn at effective ST 24.no rollConstriction Attack, effective ST 24 (thrust 2d+1 crushing)C
Acid (Corrosion Aura)Always on, no attack roll. Any organic or metal creature or object touching the pudding takes 1d-1 corrosion per second; stone is unaffected. Engulfed creatures and objects take it as large-area injury. Selective, so it does not destroy what the pudding is not attacking.no roll1d-1 corrosion per secondC

  • CER recomputed from the reviewed Typical Stats through the canonical Dungeons on Automatic CER path: OR 44, PR 88, CER 132, threat tier severe.
  • Conversion baseline reported OR -3, PR 88, CER 85 (tier major). The reviewed values come from the consumer CER implementation, which rounds damage once after the damage-type multiplier and credits ranged accuracy; the conversion baseline ceilinged the damage base first and ignored range.
  • Encounter metadata derived (solitary): average number appearing 1, wandering weight 1. Encounter metadata derived for 0.2.0 from the reviewed threat tier and creature class (appearing: minor 4 / standard 2 / major 1 / severe 1, forced to 1 for solitary classes — including swarms, which are a single multi-body creature — and raised to 6 for gregarious minor creatures; wandering weight: minor 4 / standard 3 / major 2 / severe 1). The fan-conversion source states no appearing-in-numbers or wandering values, so these are derived, not source mechanics.
  • Lair, treasure, and grappling remain unpopulated in 0.2.0 by package policy: the authorized fan-conversion source states no lair, treasure, or grappling values, and review declines to invent them. See review/policy/0.2.0-empty-field-policy.md.
  • Description text is original Dungeons on Automatic prose written from this record's own converted statistics and from the project's art direction for the creature. It is not derived from the authorized fan-conversion source, which states no creature descriptions, and not from any SRD. It carries its own authorship and CC BY 4.0 terms in the description field. See review/policy/description-policy.md.
